entries.name: The Fast
entries.description: A Way of Return rite: go hungry of every remedy and the Geometry lends you clear sight.
entries.oath_text: Drink no healing salve or tincture while the Fast holds.

entries.name: Vow of Poverty
entries.description: A Way of Return rite: carry little and the record loses its grip on you.
entries.oath_text: Carry no more than 6 items when you descend.

entries.name: The Taken Name
entries.description: A Serpent's Way rite: take a name of your own and strike where the ledger is blind.
entries.oath_text: Never cross a Sphere Gate By Name or Given Back.

entries.name: The Crown Taken
entries.description: A Serpent's Way rite: seize the sovereign's authority, and answer for it.
entries.oath_text: Never cleanse at an Altar or cross a Gate Given Back.
